definition: Manually outlined visible main shoe body in the original laser-off DAVIS photograph; excludes loose laces above the body and background/stand. Fixed for both methods. No image registration, depth alignment or inferred 3D surface.
annotation_status: Post-acquisition analysis mask drawn from photograph before computing these coverage metrics. Results/photographs previously inspected; not preregistered or independently labelled. Boundary is approximate; report one-pixel erosion/dilation sensitivity.
primary_metric: Unique rounded native pixel bins containing retained stripe centres inside this mask, divided by fixed mask area. This is image-space sample coverage, not physical 3D surface completeness.
secondary_metric: Same metric restricted to shared processing rows20..105; include full-body primary metric to expose excluded lower-body region.
